long_description:
LFcarry (formerly LegionFarm) is the world's top AI-powered marketplace for gamers to hire elite pros (top 1%) for coaching, carry, boosting and pro analytics in AAA games like WoW: Forever, Destiny 2, Call of Duty, GTA 6, Apex Legends and 40+ other games. Founded in 2016, YC-backed (W20) with $17.8M raised from 20+ investors, we've served 250k+ users via two web platforms and five messenger bots, creating 10k+ jobs for Pros worldwide.

In Q2 2026 we've launched a specialized gaming SEO/page building AI tool that is operating on pro analytics training data and autonomous AI research&engineering loops available at https://lfcarry.com/guides and it became the fastest growing product marketing case in video games so far, recording a 60x+ organic monthly impressions growth with 2.5M weekly impressions across gaming guides, tier lists, weekly activities and game time planning in major AAA games. At the same time we have all operations automated for coaching, carry and boosting services that our customers can purchase from Pros at our marketplace at https://lfcarry.com/
